description: The signed-in couple's own gift tracker on Zola: mark the thank-you note of 1 gift as sent, as the gift tracker of zola.com does. Gift ID from zola_get_my_gift_tracker. Either partner can do it. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple, and call again with the same gift_id and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Zola sends no message to the guest. The couple can unmark the note on zola.com. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same gift_id

name: zola_mark_my_thank_you_sent

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of the mark of a thank-you note of the signed-in couple
